item.title: Analysing the content of submissions to Parliament’s consultation process with {ParlAT}
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: The upcoming version of {ParlAT} allows you to quickly retrieve the content of submissions to the public consultation process of Austria’s Parliament (‘Stellungnahmen im Begutachtungsverfahren’). Here, we look into the submissions on the initially proposed Federal Prosecutor’s Office and analyse the extracted content with an LLM to identify the main contra-arguments put forward.

item.title: {risAT}: Climate change in asylum-related decisions of the Austrian Federal Administrative Court (BVwG)
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: Using {risAT} to search Austrian Federal Administrative Court (BVwG) asylum decisions for references to climate change (Klimawandel).
